headline: Refencing & Rigidity · Allport 1954

items.title: Affective-Belief Coupling
items.detail: Combines emotional antipathy with an overgeneralized belief structure.

items.title: Counter-Evidence Resistance
items.detail: Habitual prejudice rejects corrective empirical facts to preserve the group stereotype.

items.title: Refencing Device
items.detail: Contradictory individuals are quarantined as isolated exceptions, leaving the rule intact.

sources: Allport (1954), The Nature of Prejudice; The Original Power, §2.2
